data.name: Aggrieve
data.detailed_description:
A Class-based 3D Arena Fighting Game focused on movement, abilities and knockback, where traditional hitstun does not apply. Players fight each other by timing your abilities right, managing your resources and outplaying your opponent. Each class offers a unique playstyle with different strengths and weaknesses!

The last one standing wins!

The game features:

  • A plethora of classes to choose from, with many unique class roles: Fighters, Mages, Tanks, Rushers, Supports and Hexers. Each class has 4 regular abilities, 1 active ability and 1 passive ability.

  • Mana & Cooldown based combat, where resource management is vital to either surviving a fight or overwhelming your opponent in an instant.

  • Many Maps varying from gimmick to standard.

  • Different gamemodes, such as players fighting as individuals or teams.

  • Round based matches, based on the combinations of chosen classes, map and gamemode.

Class Synergies:

  • Class vary with different strengths and weaknesses, know what class your opponent has and fight around that!

  • For example, there are classes that utilize buffs and debuffs, which become very useful in Team gamemodes!

data.short_description: Aggrieve is a class-based 3D Arena Fighter centered around casting unique abilities, where traditional hitstun does not apply. Every fight is about resources, positioning, and mastering all kinds of unique classes & playstyles.

  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Support for OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
